text.text_excerpt: This place was really cool. We were a little reluctant walking there from where we were staying, as we had heard that Treme was a little unsafe at night, however we felt perfectly safe walking to the lounge. Later on, when we wanted to get money out of the nearest ATM, one of the guys working at the lounge offered to take us there, which was really cool of him. The place itself has an awesome painting on the front wall outside, and inside has a full bar and plenty of seating. We went to see the Treme brass band who we heard were amazing, and we were blown away. They started at 10 and were still playing when we left at 12, having only taken a 10 minute break. Very cool hole in the wall joint that features the Treme Brass Band on Wednesday nights in the famous Treme neighborhood...just a stones throw away from the French Quarter. To see this awesome band it was a $10 cover which is not bad to see/hear some bad ass jazz. There isn't an ATM here so you will need to bring cash for the cover but the bar accepts debit/credit cards. There is a woman tucked in the corner behind the door that you would miss if you don't look to your right when you walk in. Don't worry, you will not get away with not paying the cover as there is an awesome woman by the name of Gladys that will make sure you turn around and pay...lol. This place is open for business and it was one of the most down-home, memorable experiences we had in NOLA. Gladys is a wonderful host and not only does she take care you, she gets you up dancing to show your appreciation of the music. It was our lucky night to see the historic Tremé Brass Brand live! It's as good as it gets!!! Highly recommended to have an authentic experience and avoid the tourist trap spots in the quarter!!!
